newsitem.title: UK: PSL Group invests one mln stg in UK freight hub.
newsitem.headline: PSL Group invests one mln stg in UK freight hub.

text.p: British forwarder PSL Group said it is investing nearly one million stg in a new purpose-built freight hub in the British Midlands to meet increased freight demand.
The new 18,250 sq ft facility is under construction on a 1.25 acre site at Hinckley and is scheduled to be opened in September.
The new Midlands hub, which combines 15,750 sq ft of warehouse space and 2,SOO sq ft of offices has ten elevated loading bays with dock levellers.

"Our domestic and international traffic in the Midlands has increased four fold over the last few years and we urgently need to enhance our freight handling capacity," said Brian Benton, PSL's finance director.
"Our investment of nearly one million stg in the new purpose-built hub will allow for a doubling or trebling of traffic over the next five years," he added.
The PSL Group offers a full range of world-wide multimodal forwarding services and is involved in all aspects of the road, air and sea freight forwarding business.
